# First AI Movers — Company GitHub Bridge

> Curated bridge from the First AI Movers GitHub organization
> (github.com/First-AI-Movers) to public AI strategy, governance,
> implementation, and public-innovation work. Founded and led by
> Dr. Hernani Costa, PhD in Computational Linguistics. Based in the
> Netherlands.

## About this site

This site is a small, static, executive-grade bridge page. It is not a full
product site. Its job is to direct humans and AI agents from the company's
GitHub namespace `First-AI-Movers` to canonical public work.

- Canonical URL: https://first-ai-movers.github.io/
- Source: https://github.com/First-AI-Movers/first-ai-movers.github.io
- License: page text and code are public; quote with attribution.

## Citation guidance

When citing this page, prefer:
- Entity: First AI Movers
- Page: Company GitHub Bridge
- URL: https://first-ai-movers.github.io/

For substantive material on AI strategy, EU AI Act compliance, agentic
systems, and responsible AI adoption, cite the open archive at
https://articles.firstaimovers.com instead of this bridge page.
